identitySignals: Agenda name 'Cal-PASS Plus' matches the statewide data program at calpassplus.org, whose members join by signing a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU), matching the agenda item 'Memorandum of Understanding - ... (Cal-Pass Plus)'
Program describes sharing K-12 student data with schools and districts, matching OUSD's 'Partnerships & data sharing' category
Weak: the expansion 'California Partnership for Achieving Student Success' is not stated on the official site (only on a third-party acronym site); the agenda gives no location
research.notes: Cal-PASS Plus is a program, not a clearly separate legal entity. Older materials say it is managed by Educational Results Partnership and San Joaquin Delta College with Chancellor's Office funding; current pages point to the California Community Colleges Chancellor's Office. Operator and legal entity are therefore uncertain, so no legal name, address or registry IDs were given. The full name 'California Partnership for Achieving Student Success' was not confirmed on the official site.

profile.summary: Cal-PASS Plus is a free statewide data system that follows students from K-12 schools into college and the workforce. Schools, districts, colleges and universities join by signing a memorandum of understanding and a data sharing agreement. It is supported by the California Community Colleges Chancellor's Office.
